response.rationale: The artifact never states the rule verbatim (the note asking why .get() is used instead of the hook appears collapsed, without its answer text), so support is not explicit. However, the usage examples consistently show useStore used inside components to subscribe to store values that determine what is rendered (cart flyout visibility, cart item list), while the one read performed during an event-driven helper (addCartItem, called on form submission) uses .get() rather than the hook. From this demonstrated pattern it can be inferred that the store-reading hook is for reads that feed the rendered interface, not for reads inside event handlers, matching option 4.
